def_en: A tool with pointed parts used to pick up and eat food.

def_fr: Sert à couper les aliments.
def_en: A tool used for cutting food.

def_en: A large spoon used for serving soup or other liquids.

def_en: A flat dish used for putting food on when eating.

def_en: A round container used for eating or drinking.
